categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Jufei Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the LED packaging industry, focusing on SMD LED device research, production, and sales. Its main product applications include mobile phones, computers, LCD TVs, display systems, automotive electronics, smart lighting, health monitoring, smart wearables, and optical sensing. The company also expands into automotive LED, Mini/Micro LED, infrared LEDs, high-end lighting, semiconductor packaging, optical components, and optical films.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced LED packaging technologies including SMD, Mini LED, Micro LED, and COB high-density integration packaging. It employs IPD R&D management systems, owns numerous patents including those acquired from Panasonic, and uses automated, intelligent production lines with AOI, SPI, and optical testing equipment. The production follows an order-driven pull system with rolling forecasts and just-in-time material procurement, supported by integrated IT systems like SAP and MES.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international brands such as Hisense, Changhong, Huawei, Xiaomi, Samsung, LG, Sony, and Sharp. The company serves industries including consumer electronics, automotive (notably new energy vehicles), high-end displays, smart wearables, medical devices, and industrial control. Its products are integrated into LCD backlights, automotive displays, smart home devices, and emerging markets like 3D sensing and optical communication.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, and Wuhu, covering major domestic markets including South China, East China, North China, and expanding overseas markets such as Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and Turkey. It also has a Hong Kong subsidiary for international trade and communication technology services, and actively pursues global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jufei Optoelectronics operates in the midstream segment of the LED industry supply chain, specializing in LED packaging and module assembly. It procures raw materials directly from manufacturers and supplies finished LED components and modules to downstream customers including OEMs and system integrators in consumer electronics and automotive sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in Mini/Micro LED technologies, automotive-grade LEDs, infrared LEDs, and high-performance optical films. It invests heavily in R&D (over 6% of revenue), collaborates with top universities, and focuses on developing high-brightness, low-cost, and reliable LED solutions. Strategic priorities include expanding automotive LED applications, advancing semiconductor packaging, and growing optical communication products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of LED products and related components, including backlight LEDs, automotive LEDs, Mini/Micro LED modules, and optical films. The company also uses agency sales channels to supplement direct sales. Income is derived from product sales to large OEM customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jufei Optoelectronics is a leading domestic player in the backlight LED packaging market in China, competing with global and regional firms such as Nichia (Japan), Seoul Semiconductor (South Korea), Everlight Electronics (Taiwan), Hongli Zhihui Group, Nationstar Optoelectronics, and Refond Optoelectronics. The company holds a strong market position with growing global market share, especially in Mini LED backlight solutions and automotive LED segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.51 billion, representing an 11.07% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 230 million, up 22.27%. Total assets reached RMB 5.33 billion, with steady growth in revenue and profitability driven by expanding Mini LED and automotive LED businesses. The company maintains a solid financial position with a 7.79% return on equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jufei Optoelectronics differentiates itself through advanced LED packaging technology, high product quality, and stable supply chain management. Its Mini/Micro LED solutions offer superior brightness, color gamut, reliability, and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional LEDs and OLEDs. The company provides customized, high-performance LED solutions with rapid response and comprehensive service, targeting high-end applications in consumer electronics and automotive sectors.
